verses.he: וַיִּסַּ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֔ו וַיָּבֹ֖א בְּאֵ֣רָה שָּׁ֑בַע וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח זְבָחִ֔ים לֵאלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֥יו יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.ar: فَٱرْتَحَلَ إِسْرَائِيلُ وَكُلُّ مَا كَانَ لَهُ وَأَتَى إِلَى بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ، وَذَبَحَ ذَبَائِحَ لإِلَهِ أَبِيهِ إِسْحَاقَ.
verses.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּמַרְאֹ֣ת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֣ב ׀ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.ar: فَكَلَّمَ ٱللهُ إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي رُؤَى ٱللَّيْلِ وَقَالَ: «يَعْقُوبُ، يَعْقُوبُ!». فَقَالَ: «هَأَنَذَا».
verses.en: And God spoke unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said: 'Jacob, Jacob.' And he said: 'Here am I.'
verses.kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here [am] I.
verses.web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י הָאֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אַל־תִּירָא֙ מֵרְדָ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יְמָה כִּֽי־לְגֹ֥וי גָּדֹ֖ול אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֥ שָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «أَنَا ٱللهُ، إِلَهُ أَبِيكَ. لَا تَخَفْ مِنَ ٱلنُّزُولِ إِلَى مِصْرَ، لِأَنِّي أَجْعَلُكَ أُمَّةً عَظِيمَةً هُنَاكَ.
verses.en: And He said: 'I am God, the God of thy father; fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation.
verses.kjv: And he said, I [am] God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

verses.he: אָנֹכִ֗י אֵרֵ֤ד עִמְּךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַֽעַלְךָ֣ גַם־עָלֹ֑ה וְיֹוסֵ֕ף יָשִׁ֥ית יָדֹ֖ו עַל־עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: أَنَا أَنْزِلُ مَعَكَ إِلَى مِصْرَ، وَأَنَا أُصْعِدُكَ أَيْضًا. وَيَضَعُ يُوسُفُ يَدَهُ عَلَى عَيْنَيْكَ».
verses.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again; and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.'
verses.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up [again:] and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

verses.he: וַיָּ֥קָם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם בָּעֲגָלֹ֕ות אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח פַּרְעֹ֖ה לָשֵׂ֥את אֹתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَقَامَ يَعْقُوبُ مِنْ بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ، وَحَمَلَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَعْقُوبَ أَبَاهُمْ وَأَوْلَادَهُمْ وَنِسَاءَهُمْ فِي ٱلْعَجَلَاتِ ٱلَّتِي أَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ لِحَمْلِهِ.
verses.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.he: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽכְשׁוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְכָל־זַרְעֹ֥ו אִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَأَخَذُوا مَوَاشِيَهُمْ وَمُقْتَنَاهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱقْتَنَوْا فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ، وَجَاءُوا إِلَى مِصْرَ. يَعْقُوبُ وَكُلُّ نَسْلِهِ مَعَهُ.
verses.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him;
verses.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

verses.he: בָּנָ֞יו וּבְנֵ֤י בָנָיו֙ אִתֹּ֔ו בְּנֹתָ֛יו וּבְנֹ֥ות בָּנָ֖יו וְכָל־זַרְעֹ֑ו הֵבִ֥יא אִתֹּ֖ו מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃ ס
verses.ar: بَنُوهُ وَبَنُو بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ، وَبَنَاتُهُ وَبَنَاتُ بَنِيهِ وَكُلُّ نَسْلِهِ، جَاءَ بِهِمْ مَعَهُ إِلَى مِصْرَ.
verses.en: his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.kjv: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

verses.he: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמֹ֧ות בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַבָּאִ֥ים מִצְרַ֖יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּבָנָ֑יו בְּכֹ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَاءُوا إِلَى مِصْرَ: يَعْقُوبُ وَبَنُوهُ. بِكْرُ يَعْقُوبَ رَأُوبَيْنُ.
verses.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י רְאוּבֵ֑ן חֲנֹ֥וךְ וּפַלּ֖וּא וְחֶצְרֹ֥ון וְכַרְמִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو رَأُوبَيْنَ: حَنُوكُ وَفَلُّو وَحَصْرُونُ وَكَرْمِي.
verses.en: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעֹ֗ון יְמוּאֵ֧ל וְיָמִ֛ין וְאֹ֖הַד וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֑חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽית׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو شِمْعُونَ: يَمُوئِيلُ وَيَامِينُ وَأُوهَدُ وَيَاكِينُ وَصُوحَرُ وَشَأُولُ ٱبْنُ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيَّةِ.
verses.en: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ון קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو لَاوِي: جِرْشُونُ وَقَهَاتُ وَمَرَارِي.
verses.en: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְאֹונָ֛ן וְשֵׁלָ֖ה וָפֶ֣רֶץ וָזָ֑רַח וַיָּ֨מָת עֵ֤ר וְאֹונָן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְרֹ֥ון וְחָמֽוּל׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو يَهُوذَا: عِيرٌ وَأُونَانُ وَشِيلَةُ وَفَارَصُ وَزَارَحُ. وَأَمَّا عِيرٌ وَأُونَانُ فَمَاتَا فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ. وَكَانَ ٱبْنَا فَارَصَ: حَصْرُونَ وَحَامُولَ.
verses.en: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר תֹּולָ֥ע וּפֻוָּ֖ה וְיֹ֥וב וְשִׁמְרֹֽון׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو يَسَّاكَرَ: تُولَاعُ وَفَوَّةُ وَيُوبُ وَشِمْرُونُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Iob, and Shimron.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י זְבוּלֻ֑ן סֶ֥רֶד וְאֵלֹ֖ון וְיַחְלְאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو زَبُولُونَ: سَارَدُ وَإِيلُونُ وَيَاحَلْئِيلُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה ׀ בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָֽלְדָ֤ה לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּפַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דִּינָ֣ה בִתֹּ֑ו כָּל־נֶ֧פֶשׁ בָּנָ֛יו וּבְנֹותָ֖יו שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֹֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو لَيْئَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ وَلَدَتْهُمْ لِيَعْقُوبَ فِي فَدَّانَ أَرَامَ مَعَ دِينَةَ ٱبْنَتِهِ. جَمِيعُ نُفُوسِ بَنِيهِ وَبَنَاتِهِ ثَلَاثٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ.
verses.en: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah; all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.kjv: These [be] the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters [were] thirty and three.
verses.web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד צִפְיֹ֥ון וְחַגִּ֖י שׁוּנִ֣י וְאֶצְבֹּ֑ן עֵרִ֥י וַֽאֲרֹודִ֖י וְאַרְאֵלִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو جَادَ: صِفْيُونُ وَحَجِّي وَشُونِي وَأَصْبُونُ وَعِيرِي وَأَرُودِي وَأَرْئِيلِي.
verses.en: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֣רַח אֲחֹתָ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو أَشِيرَ: يِمْنَةُ وَيِشْوَةُ وَيِشْوِي وَبَرِيعَةُ، وَسَارَحُ هِيَ أُخْتُهُمْ. وَٱبْنَا بَرِيعَةَ: حَابِرُ وَمَلْكِيئِيلُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

verses.he: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י זִלְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְלֵאָ֣ה בִתֹּ֑ו וַתֵּ֤לֶד אֶת־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو زِلْفَةَ ٱلَّتِي أَعْطَاهَا لَابَانُ لِلَيْئَةَ ٱبْنَتِهِ، فَوَلَدَتْ هَؤُلَاءِ لِيَعْقُوبَ، سِتَّ عَشَرَةَ نَفْسًا.
verses.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bore unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, [even] sixteen souls.
verses.web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

verses.he: בְּנֵ֤י רָחֵל֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יַעֲקֹ֔ב יֹוסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.ar: اِبْنَا رَاحِيلَ ٱمْرَأَةِ يَعْقُوبَ: يُوسُفُ وَبَنْيَامِينُ.
verses.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.he: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְיֹוסֵף֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לֹּו֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פֹּ֥וטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹ֑ן אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَوُلِدَ لِيُوسُفَ فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ: مَنَسَّى وَأَفْرَايِمُ، ٱللَّذَانِ وَلَدَتْهُمَا لَهُ أَسْنَاتُ بِنْتُ فُوطِي فَارَعَ كَاهِنِ أُونٍ.
verses.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On bore unto him.
verses.kjv: ¶ And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֤לַע וָבֶ֙כֶר֙ וְאַשְׁבֵּ֔ל גֵּרָ֥א וְנַעֲמָ֖ן אֵחִ֣י וָרֹ֑אשׁ מֻפִּ֥ים וְחֻפִּ֖ים וָאָֽרְדְּ׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو بَنْيَامِينَ: بَالَعُ وَبَاكَرُ وَأَشْبِيلُ وَجِيرَا وَنَعْمَانُ وَإِيحِي وَرُوشُ وَمُفِّيمُ وَحُفِّيمُ وَأَرْدُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Benjamin [were] Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

verses.he: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖ד לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو رَاحِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ وُلِدُوا لِيَعْقُوبَ. جَمِيعُ ٱلنُّفُوسِ أَرْبَعَ عَشَرَةَ.
verses.en: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob; all the souls were fourteen.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls [were] fourteen.
verses.web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

verses.he: וּבְנֵי־דָ֖ן חֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.ar: وَٱبْنُ دَانَ: حُوشِيمُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.web: The son of Dan: Hushim.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י נַפְתָּלִ֑י יַחְצְאֵ֥ל וְגוּנִ֖י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשִׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو نَفْتَالِي: يَاحَصْئِيلُ وَجُونِي وَيِصْرُ وَشِلِّيمُ.
verses.en: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.he: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְרָחֵ֣ל בִּתֹּ֑ו וַתֵּ֧לֶד אֶת־אֵ֛לֶּה לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב כָּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ שִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو بِلْهَةَ ٱلَّتِي أَعْطَاهَا لَابَانُ لِرَاحِيلَ ٱبْنَتِهِ. فَوَلَدَتْ هَؤُلَاءِ لِيَعْقُوبَ. جَمِيعُ ٱلْأَنْفُسِ سَبْعٌ.
verses.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bore unto Jacob; all the souls were seven.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls [were] seven.
verses.web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

verses.he: כָּל־הַ֠נֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָ֨ה לְיַעֲקֹ֤ב מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י יְרֵכֹ֔ו מִלְּבַ֖ד נְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָשֵֽׁשׁ׃
verses.ar: جَمِيعُ ٱلنُّفُوسِ لِيَعْقُوبَ ٱلَّتِي أَتَتْ إِلَى مِصْرَ، ٱلْخَارِجَةِ مِنْ صُلْبِهِ، مَا عَدَا نِسَاءَ بَنِي يَعْقُوبَ، جَمِيعُ ٱلنُّفُوسِ سِتٌّ وَسِتُّونَ نَفْسًا.
verses.en: All the souls belonging to Jacob that came into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six.
verses.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls [were] threescore and six;
verses.web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֥י יֹוסֵ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־יֻלַּד־לֹ֥ו בְמִצְרַ֖יִם נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׁנָ֑יִם כָּל־הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ לְבֵֽית־יַעֲקֹ֛ב הַבָּ֥אָה מִצְרַ֖יְמָה שִׁבְעִֽים׃ פ
verses.ar: وَٱبْنَا يُوسُفَ ٱللَّذَانِ وُلِدَا لَهُ فِي مِصْرَ نَفْسَانِ. جَمِيعُ نُفُوسِ بَيْتِ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلَّتِي جَاءَتْ إِلَى مِصْرَ سَبْعُونَ.
verses.en: And the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls; all the souls of the house of Jacob, that came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, [were] two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, [were] threescore and ten.
verses.web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

verses.he: וְאֶת־יְהוּדָ֞ה שָׁלַ֤ח לְפָנָיו֙ אֶל־יֹוסֵ֔ף לְהֹורֹ֥ת לְפָנָ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ يَهُوذَا أَمَامَهُ إِلَى يُوسُفَ لِيُرِيَ ٱلطَّرِيقَ أَمَامَهُ إِلَى جَاسَانَ، ثُمَّ جَاءُوا إِلَى أَرْضِ جَاسَانَ.
verses.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.kjv: ¶ And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.web: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.he: וַיֶּאְסֹ֤ר יֹוסֵף֙ מֶרְכַּבְתֹּ֔ו וַיַּ֛עַל לִקְרַֽאת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אָבִ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיֵּרָ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וַיִּפֹּל֙ עַל־צַוָּארָ֔יו וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל־צַוָּארָ֖יו עֹֽוד׃
verses.ar: فَشَدَّ يُوسُفُ مَرْكَبَتَهُ وَصَعِدَ لِٱسْتِقْبَالِ إِسْرَائِيلَ أَبِيهِ إِلَى جَاسَانَ. وَلَمَّا ظَهَرَ لَهُ وَقَعَ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ وَبَكَى عَلَى عُنُقِهِ زَمَانًا.
verses.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־יֹוסֵ֖ף אָמ֣וּתָה הַפָּ֑עַם אַחֲרֵי֙ רְאֹותִ֣י אֶת־פָּנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י עֹודְךָ֖ חָֽי׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِسْرَائِيلُ لِيُوسُفَ: «أَمُوتُ ٱلْآنَ بَعْدَ مَا رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَكَ أَنَّكَ حَيٌّ بَعْدُ».
verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph: 'Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.'
verses.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou [art] yet alive.
verses.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יֹוסֵ֤ף אֶל־אֶחָיו֙ וְאֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאֹֽמְרָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אַחַ֧י וּבֵית־אָבִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֖עַן בָּ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِإِخْوَتِهِ وَلِبَيْتِ أَبِيهِ: «أَصْعَدُ وَأُخْبِرُ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَقُولُ لَهُ: إِخْوَتِي وَبَيْتُ أَبِي ٱلَّذِينَ فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ جَاءُوا إِلَيَّ.
verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house: 'I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and will say unto him: My brethren, and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which [were] in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

verses.he: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ רֹ֣עֵי צֹ֔אן כִּֽי־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הָ֑יוּ וְצֹאנָ֧ם וּבְקָרָ֛ם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.ar: وَٱلرِّجَالُ رُعَاةُ غَنَمٍ، فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا أَهْلَ مَوَاشٍ، وَقَدْ جَاءُوا بِغَنَمِهِمْ وَبَقَرِهِمْ وَكُلِّ مَا لَهُمْ.
verses.en: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.kjv: And the men [are] shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

verses.he: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּֽי־יִקְרָ֥א לָכֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַ֖ר מַה־מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: فَيَكُونُ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَالَ: مَا صِنَاعَتُكُمْ؟
verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say: What is your occupation?
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What [is] your occupation?
verses.web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

verses.he: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִקְנֶ֜ה הָי֤וּ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִנְּעוּרֵ֣ינוּ וְעַד־עַ֔תָּה גַּם־אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בַּעֲב֗וּר תֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן כִּֽי־תֹועֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם כָּל־רֹ֥עֵה צֹֽאן׃
verses.ar: أَنْ تَقُولُوا: عَبِيدُكَ أَهْلُ مَوَاشٍ مُنْذُ صِبَانَا إِلَى ٱلْآنَ، نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا جَمِيعًا. لِكَيْ تَسْكُنُوا فِي أَرْضِ جَاسَانَ. لِأَنَّ كُلَّ رَاعِي غَنَمٍ رِجْسٌ لِلْمِصْرِيِّينَ».
verses.en: that ye shall say: Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers; that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.'
verses.kjv: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, [and] also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd [is] an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
